create.title: Target-sized half-lattice centering for the exact M1 kernel
create.statement_tex: For the exact two-sided M1 frequency block with its fixed actual spatial profile and hard endpoint, choose c in (1/2)Z with |X-c|<=1/4. Then M_(1,L)(D;X)=sum_d chi_4(d)w_D(d)V_(L,H)(c/d)+O_w(L+X^epsilon), uniformly for X^(1/4)<=D<=X^(1/2) and 1<=L<=H asymp D X^(-1/4). Changed nearest-product assignments satisfy d|2c and 2c/d odd and are divisor-bounded; all other terms cost O(L) by ||V'||_infinity<<L and sum_(d asymp D)|w_D(d)|/d<<1. The top cutoff is held fixed, so the lemma includes the hard endpoint.
create.next_action: Use half-lattice centers without changing the actual spatial cutoff; charge the O(L+X^epsilon) error once per frequency block.

create.title: Disjoint-fiber obstruction to naive opposite-offset cancellation
create.statement_tex: At c in (1/2)Z, pair integer product centers c-u and c+u and define the exact nearest-product fibers F_-(u)={d:w_D(d)!=0,d|c-u,d>2u} and F_+(u)={d:w_D(d)!=0,d|c+u,d>2u}, with the harmless upper equality removed using V(1/2)=0. Then F_-(u) intersect F_+(u) is empty for every u>0. The paired odd-kernel contribution is sum_(F_-)chi_4(d)w_D(d)V(u/d)-sum_(F_+)chi_4(d)w_D(d)V(u/d). Divisibility gives V(u/d)=V(c/d) on F_- and V(u/d)=-V(c/d) on F_+, so the outer minus reverses and the two incidences reconstruct, rather than cancel, the centered M1 block. Therefore same-denominator matching, rank pairing, and symmetric-difference control provide no H/L saving. This does not obstruct collective cancellation between different denominators.
create.next_action: Reject future opposite-offset arguments unless they prove a collective correlation between unequal denominators rather than a termwise reflection.

create.title: Annular paired shifted-divisor correlation for M1
create.statement_tex: For c in (1/2)Z, dyadic U, lambda_U=min(LU/D,1,D/(LU)), G_U(u,d)=lambda_U^(-1)V_(L,H)(u/d), and the exact disjoint nearest-product fibers F_-(u),F_+(u), prove |Q_U(c;D,L)|<<_epsilon X^(1/4+epsilon)lambda_U^(-1), where Q_U is the outside-absolute signed sum over U<u<=2U of the F_- incidence minus the F_+ incidence with coefficient chi_4(d)w_D(d)G_U(u,d). The estimate must be uniform on U_1 and retain the actual profiles and divisor-dependent symbol. Summing lambda_U Q_U over annuli, together with half-lattice centering, is sufficient for the M1 target. At U=D/L it must save the factor H/L beyond the trivial divisor bound.
create.next_action: Seek ordered-denominator or bilinear cancellation between unequal divisors; do not estimate the two fibers separately.

update.next_action: Prove PSC or a weaker whole-sum ordered-denominator estimate on U_1. Opposite-offset reflection is only a reindexing and cannot supply the saving termwise.
Attack ordered-denominator cancellation for the actual M1 kernel on U_1; the exact-square control shows this mechanism can work, whereas opposite-offset divisor matching cannot.

reject.reason: The paired nearest-product divisor fibers are disjoint, and the divisibility sign on the upper kernel cancels the outer oddness sign, reconstructing the centered M1 sum.
A denominator common to the lower and upper nearest-product fibers would divide 2u while the lower cutoff requires d>2u.
Reflection of integer product centers about X preserves the integer lattice only when 2X is integral; generic X must first be moved to a half-lattice center at target-sized cost.
Separate norm estimates see two disjoint supports and discard the signed cross-correlation; they recover only the trivial D/L critical scale.
Singleton fibers refute deterministic termwise matching, but a simultaneous unmatched lower bound for both reflected products at one center requires an unproved shifted factorization correlation.

no_change.reason: The hard-top residual remains an instance of the open ordered-denominator or PSC estimate.
The final theorem remains conditional on open M9.

round_assessment.reason: Round 12 proves target-sized half-lattice centering and an exact disjoint-fiber identity, rigorously closing naive reflected-offset cancellation while isolating PSC as the honest signed correlation. It closes no new exponent region.
